create_external_sampling_solver: create an ExternalSamplingSolver instance for a sequential game with SIMPLE or FULL averaging type
run_external_sampling_iteration: run one iteration of external sampling MCCFR for each player to update regrets and average strategy
update_regrets_external_sampling: update regrets using external sampling by traversing game states and sampling opponent actions
full_update_average_policy: perform a full update of the average policy over all information states with reach probabilities
configure_average_type: configure the averaging strategy as SIMPLE for faster multiplayer convergence or FULL for unbiased estimation
